To determine how many days before the deadline Mike will finish his reading, we need to calculate the number of days it takes him to read the book and compare it to the total time allowed.

**Step 1: Calculate the number of days Mike needs to read the book.**
Mike plans to read 10 pages per day. The book has a total of 200 pages.
$$ \text{Days needed} = \frac{\text{Total pages}}{\text{Pages per day}} $$
$$ \text{Days needed} = \frac{200}{10} = 20 \text{ days} $$

**Step 2: Determine the deadline.**
The assignment is to be completed within 30 days. This means the deadline is at the end of day 30.

**Step 3: Calculate how many days before the deadline he finishes.**
Mike finishes reading on day 20. The deadline is day 30.
$$ \text{Days before deadline} = \text{Deadline day} - \text{Finish day} $$
$$ \text{Days before deadline} = 30 - 20 = 10 \text{ days} $$

Mike will finish his reading 10 days before the deadline.

Final answer: 10
